text:
ana: heads up — EU audit-log exporter is backpressuring the keystore proxy and we're seeing queued decrypts which are delaying new GPU node joins. noticed this ~08:30 UTC

michael: saw the alert, thank you. any quick numbers on queue depth / retry rate?

ana: queue depth hit ~420 requests, retry 5xx about 12% for the proxy itself. keystore errors are mostly 429 rate_limit or 503 backend unavailable. logs: `keystore_proxy: decrypt queue=423 retry=51 code=429`

leo: did we just roll the IAM conditional that tightens cross-account access to the audit shipper? might explain sudden auth failures.

sam: yeah that policy tweak landed in eu-privnet around 07:45 UTC — it scoped assume-role to a new tag condition. audit-shipper role wasn't updated. rolling back now?

michael: if we roll back, we fix auth but we'll still have backlog. we should throttle the exporter to let keystore catch up. can we flip exporter -> sampling=10% temporarily?

ana: can do. patch snippet I ran locally:```yaml
exporter:
  audit_sample_rate: 0.1
  burst_limit: 200
```

ops-bot: deploy started by sam — patch: audit-sampler -> 10% (eu-privnet). status: pending -> applied in 30s. :white_check_mark:

leo: rolling back the IAM change now + will add allow for audit-shipper role until we do a proper tag migration.

sam: rollback applied. IAM diff: `- Condition: StringEquals tag:team:infra
+ (removed)`. I also added temporary policy exception: `Action: sts:AssumeRole Resource: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/audit-shipper` with expire=3h.

michael: seeing keystore 5xx drop to <1% and queue draining. GPU joins that were stuck are progressing. Nice.

ana: cost note — sampling to 10% will reduce logs but we'll lose fidelity for ~2h. ops: do we want to keep sampling until backlog 0 or revert immediately after drain?

leo: prefer keep until drain + 15m to be safe. then revert and run a targeted replay for the missed windows if compliance ok. I'll check with compliance.

sam: quick checklist for post-mortem: 1) policy rollout checklist (include audit roles) 2) keystore autoscale rules tuned for short spikes 3) exporter rate-limits as emergency lever 4) add an alert for queued keystore decrypt > 200

michael: adding alert: `keystore.decrypt_queue > 200 for 5m` -> pager. will PR in 10m.

ana: thanks. reassigning the incident to eng-platform for post-mortem doc. final status: exporter sampled, IAM rollback + temp exception, keystore queue draining, GPU joins resumed.

leo: compliance ack pending — noted we will request replay if they require full fidelity.

ops-bot: incident closed by ops-bot. duration 42m. tags: keystore,audit,iam,eu,egress,provisioning
